description: This file contains logic for determining redirect URLs for rescheduling bookings, including handling environment-based behavior for past bookings, booking status checks, and reschedule restrictions.

methods.name: isPastBookingRescheduleBehaviourToPreventBooking
methods.description: Checks if the team ID is configured to prevent booking reschedule for past bookings based on environment variable.

methods.name: determineReschedulePreventionRedirect
methods.description: Determines the redirect URL for a reschedule request based on booking status, environment settings, and user permissions.
